programme.title: She's Lost Control
programme.desc: While studying for her master's degree, Ronah works as sexual surrogate in New York City under therapist Dr. Alan Cassidy. Cassidy refers to her a new client, Johnny, a man with intimacy issues. On their first appointment, Johnny drinks alcohol, which Ronah discourages, though she says he can discuss the matter with Cassidy. Johnny's hostility to Ronah's attempts to get him to open up eventually leads him to reveal in one session that he does not trust her and desires to strangle her. In her progress reports with Cassidy, Ronah confirms her desire to continue working with him, as she does not want to give up on him. Johnny continues to drink during their sessions, citing a guideline from Cassidy that one drink before their session is fine.

programme.title: Nostalgia
programme.desc: A man returns to his hometown of Naples, 40 years after abruptly leaving as a teen, stirring up a past which he's kept buried. He is determined to see his boyhood friend, now a leading Naples crime boss, with whom he shares a dark secret. Italian with English subtitles

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: The Wait
programme.desc: Amidst the large rooms of an old villa marked by time, Anna, emerging from a sudden bereavement, spends her days in solitude. The rugged and beautiful Sicilian countryside surrounds the house and isolates her while the fog, which is slowly climbing the slopes of Mount Etna, prevents the eye seeing any distance. Only the footsteps of Pietro, the handyman, break the silence. And all of a sudden Jeanne appears, a young woman who claims to be the girlfriend of Giuseppe, Anna's son. He invited her to Sicily to spend a few days' holiday together. Anna was unaware of Jeanne's existence. And Giuseppe is not there. But his things are all there, in his room. Soon, very soon he will return, is what Anna says, unable to reveal a truth that for her cannot be spoken. The days pass, the two women slowly get to know each other, and together they begin to wait for Easter, when Giuseppe will finally come home, and a great traditional procession will be held in the village.

programme.title: Allelujah
programme.desc: The Beth, a small community NHS geriatric facility in Yorkshire, is facing closure because of Whitehall budget cuts. Colin, a management consultant for the health department, arrives to visit his ailing ex-miner father and to make an appraisal. Meanwhile, the staff and patients are preparing a presentation for the formidable Nurse Gilpin, who is to be presented with a long service medal. Based on the successful stage play by Alan Bennett.

programme.title: The Summer We Live
programme.desc: Year 1998. Isabel, a journalism student, is forced to do her internship in the newspaper of a small Galician coastal town in order to finish her degree. When she arrives, she wants to start investigating as soon as possible, to demonstrate everything she has learned in order to become a real journalist. But the position she is assigned is the last one she expected: the writing and management of the obituaries that reach the newsroom. But this, which might seem boring at first, becomes the door to an investigation that will take her through different parts of the Spanish geography in search of an impossible love story.

programme.title: My Friend from the Park
programme.desc: Liz, a new mother, meets Rosa and they end up becoming good friends. However, their friendship takes an unexpected turn as Liz is pulled into a life of crime and instability.

programme.title: The Graduate
programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning comedy drama. Disillusioned graduate Benjamin Braddock is urged by his family to enter a business career and settle down after college, but instead he finds himself seduced by Mrs Robinson, a friend of his parents. He tries to extricate himself from the affair when he falls in love with Mrs Robinson's daughter, but finds that his own actions may have sealed his fate. Featuring the music of Simon and Garfunkel.

programme.title: Hannes
programme.desc: Born at the same place, on the same day, Hannes and Moritz grow up to be inseparable friends. But one day a tragic motorcycle accident will change their lives forever, leaving Hannes in a coma with a slim chance of recovery. Moritz refuses to give up on his friend and puts his own life aside to ensure Hannes is always loved and surrounded by life and laughter. Trying to stand his ground, Moritz will then embark on an inspiring and life-changing journey, realizing that every day is worth celebrating and proving their friendship is stronger than ever.

programme.title: Neem Me Mee
programme.desc: Six people over seventy are at a turning point in their lives. Without knowing each other, they go on a journey together.

programme.title: The Nannies
programme.desc: Angèle, a thirty-something from Ivory Coast, always cope thanks to the gift of gab and audacity. To escape from a bunch of dangerous criminals, she becomes a nanny in the uptown Paris, hired by Hélène, the single mom of eight years old Arthur. Discovering the work conditions of her colleagues, she decides to stand up for their rights, thanks to a young lawyer who will quickly fall for her.

programme.title: Hara-Kiri: Death of a Samurai
programme.desc: A tale of revenge, honor and disgrace, centering on a poverty-stricken samurai who discovers the fate of his ronin son-in-law, setting in motion a tense showdown of vengeance against the house of a feudal lord.

programme.title: Spell
programme.desc: Following the unexpected death of his fiancee, an American illustrator embarks on a soul-searching journey across the isolated Icelandic countryside, only to become drawn into a supernatural world of ancient runes and secrets. In his vulnerable state, he meets a powerful magician who can raise the dead, and locals who convince him to proceed with the ritual. Very dangerous, unless it's all in his head.

programme.title: Madame Bovary
programme.desc: Bored in her marriage to a country doctor and stifled by life in a small town, the restless Emma Bovary pursues her dreams of passion and excitement at any cost.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: Sharkwrecked: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Paul de Gelder and James Glancy bail out of an aircraft at 3500-ft to experience what it's like to crash land into some of the world's most remote and shark-infested waters.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Zoo: San Diego
programme.desc: "The Zoo: San Diego" provides a behind the scenes look at the daily lives of various species of animals and the teams that care for them. Featuring two parks, the San Diego Zoo and the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, as well as the San Diego Zoo Institute for Conservation Research, San Diego Zoo Global is home to more than 700 species and 6,500 animals. A wide range of animals are introduced, including pandas, giraffes, Galapagos tortoises, koalas, elephants, mountain lions, two baby cheetahs that are learning how to be ambassadors for their species and a flock of ostriches known as the "Spice Girls." Besides the animals, the keepers and veterinarians at both the Zoo and the Safari Park -- many of whom have dedicated their lives to caring for animals, discuss what it's like to be a part of this world-renowned zoo.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.desc: Animal Cops: Miami is a documentary reality series following dedicated animal control officers as they provide a valuable service to the animals of Miami-Dade County. Keeping a close eye on the region's creatures, both wild and domesticated, the control officers visit various locations to investigate reports of injured or sick animals, and deplorable cases of animal cruelty, ensuring they are provided with the welfare they deserve. The series also follows individuals from the Everglades Outpost nature rehabilitation centre, as they investigate reports of animals being improperly released into the wetland area.

programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: The Vet Life
programme.desc: The Vet Life is an amazing series revolving around three friends, three vets, Diarra Blue, Aubrey Ross, and Mike Lavigne and their everyday lives. These guys became friends back in University, then they worked in Las Vegas and finally moved to Texas and opened a full-service veterinary hospital of their own. The series highlights their daily routine, their duties at work and at home, their families and pets.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

programme.title: Guardians of Rescue
programme.desc: Follow a group of men and women coming from a range of backgrounds, united in their love for animals and in their mission to rescue them, as well as educate and motivate people to follow their lead. Their main concern is helping animals in need, but it is also strengthening the bond with animals that has always been present in human lives, emphasising the importance of nurturing that relationship.

programme.title: I Was Prey
programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators.

programme.title: Animal ER
programme.desc: Owners Lisa and Callu are worried about Merlin, a Great Dane who goes over on his front toes when he walks. Neurologist Annette Wessman suspects a problem in his spine or skull.

programme.title: Rugged Justice
programme.desc: Animal Planet's Rugged Justice follows the officers from Washington State's Department of Fish and Wildlife Law Enforcement as they guard the vast borders. It is an elite unit that protect people and wildlife, patrolling coastal areas, mountainous terrains and rugged roads of rainforests. Every day brings a new challenge, dispatchers receive around 25.000 calls annually, every of which requires prompt reaction.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

Giada has quite an impressive background of culinary training from Le Cordon Bleu in Paris, which combined with her own unique Californian charm creates her one-of-a-kind recognizable style. In Giada at Home she focuses on cooking at home for friends and family for different occasions and on party planning. programme.title: Alaska Monsters

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Kindig Customs: Road To The Ridler
programme.desc: The pinnacle of the custom car world is the Don Ridler Award, given out every year at the Detroit Autorama. Dave Kindig has always had a Ridler-sized itch he needed to scratch, and has finally found the right client and idea to make it a reality.

programme.title: Mike Brewer: Born Dealer
programme.desc: Mike takes the family on a trip down memory lane. He finds new cars for his dad and sister and helps Richard Hammond's mum sell her MX5 for charity.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Reality series focuses on the amazing opportunity to dive into American street racing world. Look at how need for speed unites people and find out what adrenaline addicts are ready for in Oklahoma, unofficial capital of illegal street racing. Only top racers participate in the competition, they want to appear and stay at the A-list, everything they have to do is to try to squeeze as much performance out of their vehicles as possible.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: As the modern world becomes progressively automated and mechanised it's easy to become detached from how things are made and how they work. The hit series returns to uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How the seemingly mundane are often the result of highly sophisticated engineering and production processes. This fascinating behind-the-scenes journey delves deep into the production of everyday modern items from surfboards to satchels and trombones to cricket bats.

And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: Filthy Fortunes
programme.desc: The show follows extreme-cleaning specialist Matt Paxton, dubbed the "King of Hoards," as he wades into America's most cluttered homes in search of hidden treasures. Think "American Pickers" meets "Hoarders," with a dash of financial gamble thrown in for good measure.

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters
programme.desc: Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

Episodes see the team bring to life a unique Pantera that was hot-rodded by Carroll Shelby; beef up a '68 Charger with some up-to-date mechanics; make-over a couple of Hollywood star vehicles built by legendary George Barris; and re-build a '72 Mach-1 Mustang resto-mod for NASCAR superstar Joey Logano.

In each episode Dave and his team review a car, create a design, then the team takes it apart and rebuilds to create a one-of-a-kind gem. Things get really ugly before they get pretty. Dave has the best team of top mechanics, technicians and fabricators in the business, quality is their only focus when they create the baddest bitchin' rides.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

Sitting in a comfortable chair in your warm apartment just try to imagine how it really is when electricity and running water is not inevitable fact of life. The Kilchers hunt, go fishing, garden, gather, raise livestock in order to survive Alaska's uncontrollable power and wilderness.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: Sister Wives
programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. From their unconventional family structure and living arrangements to financial challenges, each half hour episode exposes the inner workings of a polygamist household, revealing the unexpectedly tight-knit and loving relationships between Kody's wives. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Bad Hair Day

programme.desc: Dr. Colón faces more chiropractic challenges when she treats a woman with CMT who hopes to stand at her daughter's wedding, a big breasted woman with extreme neck pain, and the show's sound man, who was born with cerebral palsy and an uneven body.

programme.desc: The summer season is frantic for maritime authorities. As drug boats and small dinghies sail towards Spanish territory, small vessels wait offshore to refuel them. Additionally, with the surge in tourism, the number of boats and jet skis multiplies. The Spanish Coastguards will have to confront situations that could end in tragedy.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport employees reunite travelers with their lost items, including a pair of ornate Shriners fezzes, a bride's pearl necklace, and a $12,000 Jaeger watch. In New Orleans, a mom retrieves the wallet she left on the plane after buying snacks for her kids, and in Alabama shoppers from around the country line up for hours to enter Unclaimed Baggage's giant annual sale of lost ski equipment.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport workers undertake true detective work to trace the owner of a duffel bag brimming with old family photos. A woman searches for Christmas decorations that are part of a family gifting tradition. In Tampa, the lost and found department donates items to a local women's shelter, including a $700 purse. In New Orleans, a young man loses his wallet upon arriving for a college tour.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: When wild weather and traffic convoys cause carnage, Thord races against time to rescue stranded drivers. In the North, Ole Henrik takes the company's brand new tow-truck on its first mission. The task is to rescue a truck that crashed deep into a snow covered ditch, then flipped 90 degrees onto its side. Ole Henrik's eager to put the new flagship rescue truck to the test, to see if it's worth the big investment.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Supercar Megabuild
programme.desc: On this episode of Supercar MegaBuild, expert mechanics Shane and Dan have one of their toughest assignments yet. They need to try to convert an Audi R8 into a Gymkhana Grid contender. That means taking an exclusive, executive supercar and turning it into mean machine that can slip and slide its way around a car assault course. Time is tight and the pressure is cranked to the max. Have the guys bitten off more than they can chew?

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Pay close attention - what you discover in this episode of Brain Games will keep you from falling for a scam. In a robbery, the victim is forced to give up money or possessions. In a scam or con, the victim hands over their valuables willingly. Each year, millions of people around the world fall for some sort of scam or fraud. Through a series of interactive games and experiments, you'll discover how easily your brain is deceived. Scammers and con artists make it their business to know how your brain works, and how to use its flaws to their advantage. Play along to discover how your brain is wired to initially believe everything it hears, what it finds most tempting in an ad or sales pitch, and how simply being human can lead you into some sticky situations. Get ready to fall hook, line, and sinker…on BRAIN GAMES.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Why does it seem like men are from Mars and women are from Venus? How can men and women look at the same world and see completely different things? Or solve the same problem two completely different ways? And in a head-to-head matchup of sheer brainpower who wins? This episode of Brain Games will reveal the surprising ways the male and female brain may be different and how its revealed in our behavior and abilities. Your gray matter will be tested through a series of interactive games and unexpected experiments hosted by relatable experts. So its time to choose sides in the ultimate battle of the sexes on Brain Games!

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Do you sometimes hear a little voice in your head, an inner critic that keeps you from performing at your best? What if we told you there's a way to change what that voice is telling you that will improve your performance in just about anything you try? It might come as a surprise, but research shows thinking positive is more than just a warm and fuzzy idea. And in this episode about positive thinking, we're going to show you how thinking positive can change your thoughts, your reality, and even your life! We're going to mess with your mood to show you what really makes that glass seem half empty or half full; why people who stand tall, stand happy; and how to turn that frown upside down. So get ready to stop worrying and be happy, on Brain Games.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Just minutes after taking off from Lima, the crew of Aeroperú Flight 603 is overwhelmed by a series of conflicting error messages. Flying blind through thick clouds—and unable to confirm either airspeed or altitude—the pilots don't know which alarm they can trust. A controller steps in and dispatches a rescue plane to guide them back to the airport, but help doesn't arrive in time. And just as the crew is troubleshooting over open ocean, the Boeing 757 plunges into the Pacific, instantly killing everyone on board. A Navy expedition to the sea floor proves the plane was intact when it hit the water and successfully retrieves the plane's black boxes. A single image of the wreckage reveals a minor maintenance glitch with deadly repercussions, while the flight data reveals the crew was ill-prepared for a fatal cascade of erroneous data.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Minutes before the noise curfew, a privately chartered Gulfstream III is on final approach to Aspen, Colorado amid heavy snow. And though the plane directly ahead aborts its landing due to poor visibility, AvJet N303GA emerges from the clouds, tries to line up with the single runway, and crashes—instantly claiming the lives of all 18 people on board. With no signs of mechanical failure, investigators learn the plane dropped well below minimum altitude on approach. And though a deep dive into the pilots' backgrounds reveals no red flags, the plane's wreckless trajectory begins to make sense when they look into what happened before the late takeoff from Los Angeles. Client pressure blurred the lines between safety and customer satisfaction. And as a result, the confused pilots were determined to land the plane at Aspen—in spite of the risks. Final

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: The Deepwater Horizon rig has finished drilling the Macondo Well for BP in the Gulf of Mexico. The well, in water 1500m deep, extends to a depth of 4000m. The crew test the well to ensure it is safely sealed so the Deepwater Horizon rig can move on before another rig starts oil extraction. But just hours after the well passes its safety test, flammable gas and crude oil shoot out of the well, enveloping the rig in flames and killing 11 workers. Seconds from Disaster investigates the series of decisions and failings that culminated in the catastrophe and the world's biggest accidental marine oil spill.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: At 9.20pm on 26 November 2008 gunmen burst into Mumbai's luxury Trident Oberoi hotel, firing indiscriminately. A Jewish study centre at Nariman House, popular with American and Israeli Jews, is targeted around the same time, followed by tourist hangout Café Leopold, the city's most luxurious hotel, the Taj Mahal Palace, and the CST, one of the world's busiest rail stations. These unprecedented commando-style attacks, which leave 166 dead, have clearly targeted both the Indian public and Western visitors. Seconds from Disaster reveals the failings that allowed 10 terrorists free reign of India's largest city - killing at will - in front of the world's cameras for nearly 3 horrifying days.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: The Inca fortress of Sacsayhuamán stands high above Cusco as a colossal mystery of construction. Its gargantuan stones, so precisely fitted, seem to defy rational explanation and have given rise to tales of demonic assistance. Deep in Rajasthan, India, the Chand Baori stepwell plunges 13 stories into the earth, its 3,500 perfectly arranged steps forming a hypnotic geometry so meticulous that locals whisper of unholy pacts. And in the heart of Paris, the Notre-Dame Cathedral soars skyward, its Gothic spires and intricate ironwork pushed medieval engineering to such extremes that stories circulated of dark bargains. Did the creators of these structures truly strike a "deal with the devil," or do these wonders simply reflect the often-misunderstood genius of our ancestors?

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Commissioned by Emperor Shah Jahan as a mausoleum for his beloved wife, the Taj Mahal stands as a crown jewel of Mughal architecture and an embodiment of eternal devotion. Beneath Germany's 11th century Speyer Cathedral, Salian emperors built a cavernous crypt, revealing astounding visions of the afterlife and their desire to secure a place in eternity. Carved high into the cliffs of Turkey, the intricate Lycian tombs offer a window into a mysterious ancient civilization's vibrant beliefs about the afterlife. Each monumental structure holds valuable clues to unravel the mysteries of how ancient ancestors approached the inevitability of death. More than mere burial sites, they reveal complex philosophies about life and what lies beyond.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Clueless carriers, and people betrayed. Officials from Airport Security Colombia and Peru must remain vigilant. A woman's boyfriend asks her to carry bottles. She has no idea they contain liquid cocaine. A man with cocaine in his suitcase claims his son-in-law is responsible. A US woman may have been tricked into drug-trafficking. A construction worker is given a bag with cocaine. Of two Ukrainian friends, one claims to have tricked the other.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Drug-trafficking is risky business. In Airport Security Colombia and Peru, suspects try to evade detection. A couple traveling to Punta Cana is not what they seem. The man risked it all for money. A woman carrying cocaine on her body did it to start a business and help her family. A first-time carrier hiding cocaine in traditional handicraft mats gambles and loses. A Syrian man uses false documents twice, hoping to reunite with family in Europe.

programme.title: Legal Marijuana in America: The New Green Rush
programme.desc: The war on pot is not over - marijuana is both legal and illicit in America. Penalties and jailtime are still a threat holding back the new cannabis economy as growers, sellers, researchers, and users, all struggle to deal with the changing rules in National Geographic's latest exploration of marijuana laws going legit.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In 16th-century France, astrologer Nostradamus wrote hundreds of cryptic verses implying impossible knowledge of future events, including the French Revolution, the Second World War, the assassination of JFK, and the attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. Who was Nostradamus, and what did he say? In Central Europe, local legends say Houska Castle guards a portal to hell and is the site of dark, storied history. Here, young poet Karel Hynek Macha had a feverish dream of a future that terrified him. In medieval Italy, St. Francis of Assisi was subjected to the world's first case of stigmata, receiving the wounds of the Christian messiah on his hands, feet and torso. Are the stigmata a blessing, a curse, or a traditional blend of legend and truth? Final

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In early-1900s Russia, Grigori Rasputin, the professed mystical healer, was both admired and disdained. Some believed he had the czar and czarina under a dark spell. The true Rasputin is hard to decipher, but his claims of prophetic powers led to a controversial and tragic role pivotal to Russian history. In China, a scholar found strange markings on ancient bones that unlocked age-old mysteries. The ancient Chinese believed these "oracle bone" markings could contain traces of the future. In Point Pleasant, West Virginia, a mysterious winged creature is sighted moments before a tragic bridge collapse. The creature, dubbed the "Mothman," sparked decades of debate. Is it real, and did it portend impending doom?

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Peru's biggest airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest problem: cocaine smuggling. Police stop a woman travelling with her 5-year-old. If she's a carrier, agents must figure out what to do with the child. A Mexican citizen is found with a large amount of beer and soft drinks. All these goods may contain cocaine. Officers uncover a creative new method of hiding cocaine in food packaging.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Peru's biggest airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest problem: cocaine smuggling. Police rush to handle a rare incident on a domestic flight: something suspicious in a Serbian citizen's bag. Agents find liquid cocaine disguised in drink bottles in another man's bag. A passenger without luggage reappears carrying a suitcase and agents rush to investigate. Counterfeit cash is uncovered in the mail facility.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Peru's biggest airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest problem: cocaine smuggling. He may be telling the truth. Or he may be trying to evade the law. A shipment of children's toys may hide a stash of cocaine.

programme.desc: On the west coast of Puerto Rico, Air and Marine Operations chase down and arrest smugglers caught tossing bales of cocaine overboard. programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Inseneritöö, mis ehitas maailma

programme.title: Inseneritöö, mis ehitas maailma

programme.title: Maailmasõda: 1914-1945

programme.title: Vanaaegne õigus

programme.title: Vana-Kreeka: sünged kroonikad

programme.desc: "Suvesangarid" on lustlik suvine saade, mis tõestab, et igas Eestimaa nurgas on midagi vaatamist ja katsetamist väärt. Kartmatud saatejuhid Indrek Vaheoja ja Kristjan Rabi proovivad erinevaid ameteid, võtavad vastu külalisi ja jagavad ellujäämise saladusi neljal õhtul nädalas. Lisaks saab Eestimaa kirjust suvest osa vaatajate koduvideote kaudu.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Taryni ja Nasseri ühised vaated moele ja küünelakkidele panevad mõlemat teisele "jah" ütlema. Kayla Tourette'i sündroom Harrisoni ei heiduta, mõlemad nõustuvad ka teise kohtinguga. Adamile meeldib Sarah, kes on aga pirtsakas ja segaduses. Adam ütleb "jah", Sarah "ei". Jaime'ile ei lähe peale Briani koertehullus. James kohtleb Rebeccat lugupidamatult ja kustutab lootused teiseks kohtinguks.

programme.title: Armastuse hind
programme.desc: Ferit toimetab Seyrani kiirelt haiglasse. Fikriye ja Ifakati vahel pinged tõusevad. Fikriye ei luba oma õel Ifakatil kauaks tema poole jääda. Kõik pereliikmed kogunevad haiglasse. Arst annab Seyrani seisundi kohta infot. Ferit ja Abidin arutlevad olukorra üle ja püüavad pressi eest kõike saladuses hoida. Kaya tunnistab Sunale, et pettis teda Peliniga, kuid kahetseb seda. Ka Esme kuuleb sellest. Ferit kardab, et oht varitseb neid endiselt, kuna Mezide ja Akini surnukehad on jäljetult kadunud.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.desc: Noor naine satub Teise maailmasõja keerises mõjukat poliitikut ümbritsevate ohtlike emotsionaalsete intriigide keskmesse.

programme.title: Teekond mälestustesse
programme.desc: Kooli kõige popim õpilane, pahapoiss ja tütarlaste lemmik, peab karistuseks tegema ühiksondlikult kasulikku tööd - aitama korraldada koolinäidendit. Üksi ei saa sa selle ülesandega hakkama.

programme.title: Vabaliikumises
programme.desc: Suurlinnas elav teismeline Ren MacCormac kolib väikelinna, kus on keelustatud rockmuusika ja tantsimine. Nooruki mässumeelne vastuhakk raputab kohalikke.

programme.title: Allikas
programme.desc: USA 2006 ulmedraamaLavastaja: Darren AronofskyOsades: Hugh Jackman, Rachel Weisz, Ellen Burstyn, Mark MargolisMis siis, kui saaksid elada igavesti? See on ühe mehe teekond eesmärgiga päästa enda poolt armastatud naine. Eepiline rännak algab 16. sajandi Hispaanias, kus konkistadoor Tomas (Hugh Jackman) asub teele Uude Maailma, et leida legendaarne "nooruse allikas", mis kinkivat igavese elu. Tänapäevase teadlase Tommy Creona pingutab ta meeleheitlikult, et leida ravimit vähi vastu, mis hävitab ta armastatud abikaasat Isabeli (Rachel Weisz). Rännates läbi kosmoseavaruste 26. sajandi astronaudina, hakkab Tom viimaks mõistma mõistatusi, mis on teda tuhatkond aastat vaevanud. Kolm lugu sulavad kokku ühes tões, kui kõigi ajastute Thomas - sõdalane, teadlane ja kosmoserändur - saab mõistma elu, armastust, surma ja uuestisündi.

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Ära iial ütle iial
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilm jälgib Justin Bieberit ja näitab kaadreid tema esinemistelt 2010. aasta turneel.

programme.title: Keelatud tants 2
programme.desc: Mässumeelne tänavatantsija Andie satub elitaarsesse Marylandi kunstikooli. Neiu püüab korraga nii uue kohaga sobituda kui iseendaks jääda.

programme.title: Piinatud geenius
programme.desc: USA 2001 draama Lavastaja: Ron Howard Osades: Russell Crowe, Jennifer Connelly, Ed Harris, Josh Lucas, Adam Goldberg Parima filmi, stsenaariumi, lavastaja ning naiskõrvalosa Oscari võitnud film matemaatik John Nashi värvikast elust. Meeldiva välimuse ja ekstsentrilise olemisega teadlane John Forbes Nash Jr. (Russell Crowe) tegi üsna noores eas avastuse, mis viis ta rahvusvahelise tuntuse lävele ning ühtlasi USA luure vaatevälja. Paraku jäi lõplik erialane läbilöök saavutamata skisofreenia tõttu. Võideldes takistustega, mis on paljusid hävitanud, leidis Nash kõige enam tuge oma armastavalt abikaasalt Alicialt (Jennifer Connelly). Pärast aastatepikkust tragöödiat saabus Nashi tähetund 1994. aastal, mil see elav legend sai oma töö eest Nobeli preemia.

programme.title: Poiss triibulises pidzaamas
programme.desc: Brunol on uues kodus igav ja ta kolab ringi ümberkaudsetes metsades. Ta leiab kummalise aia, mille taga on mustvalgesse pidžaamasse riietatud poiss. Alguse saab ootamatu sõprus.

programme.title: Aiad
programme.desc: USA / Kanada 2016 draama Lavastaja:Denzel Washington Osades:Denzel Washington, Viola Davis, Stephen McKinley Henderson Troy Maxson (Denzel Washington) töötab prügiautojuhina 1950ndate Pittsburghis. Maxsoni unistus oli saada professionaalseks pesapalluriks, kuid kui profiliigadesse hakati mustanahalisi sportlasi lubama, peeti teda juba liiga vanaks. Luhtunud võimaluse tõttu kibestunud mees tekitab peres veelgi rohkem pingeid, kui rikub poja võimaluse kohtuda kolledžijalgpalli värbajaga.

programme.title: Anonüümne
programme.desc: Pseudoajalooline kostüümidraama, milles seatakse kahtluse alla 17. sajandi kuulsaima inglise näitekirjaniku William Shakespeare'i olemasolu.

programme.title: Tänavajurist
programme.desc: USA 2011 draamaLavastaja: Brad FurmanOsades: Matthew McConaughey, Marisa Tomei, Ryan PhillippeMickey Haller (Matthew McConaughey) on edukas advokaat, kes enamjaolt tegeleb tööasjadega L.A.'s ringi sõites, tema kontoriks on luksusauto ning enamus tema kliente on silmnähtavalt süüdi olevad narkoärikad ja gängsterid, kellest enamus on ta ka trellidest päästnud. Kuid ühel hetkel pakutakse talle tööd kaitsta Louis Rouleti (Ryan Phillippe), rikkast kinnisvaramaaklerit, keda süüdistatakse ühe neiu mõrvakatses ja väärkohtlemises. Louis seda süüdistust omaks loomulikult ei võta ning samuti usub ka Mickey tema süütusesse, kuniks päevavalgele hakkavad tulema nii mõnedki faktid, mis hakkavad tõsiselt häirima Mickey kohtuasja lahendamise strateegiat ja ka tema usku Louis'i süütusesse.

programme.title: Legend peata ratsanikust
programme.desc: Ichabod Crane saadetakse Sleepy Hollow'sse uurima kolme inimese surma pea maharaiumise läbi. Süüdlane on legendaarne ilmutus, Peata Ratsanik.

programme.title: Kuidas teha Ameerika tekki
programme.desc: Elu ristteel olev naine peab otsustama, kas abielluda oma kihlatuge või mitte. Talle annavad nõus elutargad loobujad.

programme.title: Kuratlik
programme.desc: Prestiižika eraalgkooli sadistliku dekaani naine ja armuke sepitsevad vandenõu mehe mõrvamiseks.

programme.title: Papsid
programme.desc: Aleks hoiatab Toomast, et too oleks oma ämmaga ettevaatlik. Salapärane austaja tellib Marikalt esimese mutipeletaja. Toomas küsib Õielt, kas tema lasi mao lahti.

programme.title: Mis teil siin head on?
programme.desc: Telehommikust tuttav saatejuht Kristjan Gold on ka kirglik hobikokk. Kristjan võtab ette rännaku läbi Taani, Rootsi, Soome ja Ahvenamaa ning otsib üles mõttekaaslased, kelle jaoks toit on enamat kui kõhutäide. Ta läheb otsima inspireerivaid inimesi ja lugusid iga suutäie taga, mis skandinaavlastele kõige enam korda lähevad. Esimeses saates jõuab Kristjan Taani läänerannikule, kus ta uurib varahommikuses Ribe pagariäris taanlaste saiakeste lembust, käib kohalikus pruulikojas õlut mekkimas ja kokkab koos Taani kuulsa telekoka ja tuntud stsenaristi Adam Price'iga kalakotlette.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Kellele kuulub su süda?
programme.desc: Kui Vicki ja Simon saavad pärast suhete selgeks rääkimist väga hästi läbi, näevad sõbrad neis uut unelmate paari. Josie soovitab tal Hannes unustada ja lubadagi endal uuesti armuda. Simon saab ootamatu telefonikõne, mis teda sügavalt vapustab. Isa ja Fabian muretsevad oma isa pärast. Resi ja Anne-Marie lähevad aaret otsima, aga hoopis Bruno leiab midagi.

programme.title: Nutikas Eesti
programme.desc: Elurõõmsas mälumängusaates seigeldakse üle Eesti erinevatel festivalidel ja laatadel, külastatakse randu, hüpatakse sisse mõnda külapoodi ning otsitakse nutikaid inimesi, kellele esitada kuus põnevat mälumängu küsimust, millele äravastamisel ootab inimesi auhind. Muhedad mälumängud ja reportaažid suvisel Eestimaal. Saadet juhib Peeter Võsa ja telgitagustest toimetab auhinnatud saate "Õhtu!" meeskond.

programme.title: Suvereporter
programme.desc: Suvine uudistemagasin liigub sinna, kus Eesti suvi parajasti kõige elavamalt keeb. Saade toob vaatajani päeva olulisemad sündmused, värvikad inimesed ja meeleolukad lood rannast, linnamelust, festivalidelt, külapidudelt, aga ka Meediamaja rõdult. Reporterile omases hoogsas võtmes jõuavad ekraanile värsked uudised, elulised reportaažid, ootamatud kohtumised ja hetked, mis teevad Eesti suve eriliseks. Saatejuhid Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap hoiavad silma peal nii tõsisematel teemadel kui ka suvistel seikadel meil ja mujal maailmas.

programme.title: 15 küsimust
programme.desc: Kodumaine strateegiline mälumäng, kus mängijal on võimalus hakata panustama enda tugevustele ning samal ajal vastase nõrkusele. Mängu teeb eriliseks see, et osalejad ei pea kunagi kartma, et nad ei tea vastust ühelegi küsimusele, kuna põnev vihjete süsteem välistab selle võimaluse. Kaasakiskuvat ja huvitavat stuudio mälumängu juhib Jüri Butšakov.

programme.title: Roaldi retked
programme.desc: Endine seltskonnatäht Liis Lass on kodumaa tolmu ammu jalgelt pühkinud, kuid luksus ja glamuur pole tema elust kuhugi kadunud! Nüüd elab ja õitseb ta Singapuris - säravas linnriigis, kus tema koduks on mitmemiljoniline katusekorter ning sõiduriistaks endanimeline luksuskaater. Roald Johannson lendab sügishooaja avasaates Kagu-Aasia superrikaste paradiisi ning leiab eest rangete reeglitega metropoli, kus on keelatud muuhulgas nätsu närimine, e-sigareti tõmbamine ja, üllatus-üllatus, isegi lifti pissimine!

programme.title: Katie Fforde - Kallis afäär
programme.desc: New Yorgis elav noor assistent Flora sukeldub argimurede keskele, kui saab teada, et tema ema Liz on pikemat aega haige olnud ja pärast isa surma enam üksi toime ei tule. Flora ei tea, kuidas majanduslikult toime tulla ja vennalt abi küsida oleks võimatu, sest temal on endal pere üleval pidada. Ainsat võimalust näeb naine oksjonimaja osakutes, mille isa talle pärandas. Paraku selgub, et seegi asutus on pankroti äärel.

programme.title: Südamesoov
programme.desc: Suurpere isa Siimu elu muutus pöördumatult, kui perre sündis habraste luude haigust põdev poeg Karmo. Erilise lapse kasvatamine avas mõlema vanema südamed, mistõttu suur osa nende ajast kulub vabatahtlikena teiste aitamisele. Pere kõige suurem mure on aga seotud pojaga. Pidevad luumurrud on aheldanud esimese klassi poisi ratastooli ja koduseinte vahele, kuid vanemate südamesoov on, et nende laps saaks käia koolis nagu kõik teised temaealised.

programme.title: Naised vormis
programme.desc: Priidule leitakse uus partner Vallo, kes tundub esmapilgul liiga normaalne, et olla tõsi. Karl-Madis peab avaliku pöördumisega oma mainet puhtaks pesema. Kadri vend Kaur aitab naisi uurmises jälitades narkootilist ainet, mida vägistaja kasutab oma ohvrite uinutamiseks. Kas otsitav kurjategija võib olla Dorisele lähemal kui naised aimata oskavad?

programme.title: 100 erilist eestlast
programme.desc: Võtame kolmanda hooaja lõbusalt kokku! Parimad palad koos lisadega!

programme.title: Naabriplika
programme.desc: Kröösman saab Piibliga pähe ja muutub maailma kõige paremaks inimeseks. Vallavanem aga otsustab, et valla päästmiseks kandideeritakse Euroopa kultuuriküla tiitlile. Kahjuks selgub, et kultuurikülas peaks mingil määral toimuma ka kultuurilist tegevust. Kerepa ja Krista aga satuvad kunsti laineharjal üksteisele lähemale, kui vallavanemale meeldiks. Lõpuks on muidugi kõik jälle omavahel tülis ja nagu Esnale kombeks, ei lõpe ka Euroopa kultuuriküla projekt just kõige paremini.

programme.title: Küladetektiivid
programme.desc: Kuriteopaigale jõudes tabab uurijaid kurb üllatus - kahe aasta eest tapeti samas majas selle omanik Maria Wittenberg, nüüd aga tuleb välja uurida Maria toonase elukaaslase surma asjaolud. Esimese vihje annab Prantlile ja Hansenile Roland Morchel, rääkides Thomas Wolfi tülist tapetuga. Vaatamata keerulisele uurimistööle leiab Prantl aega alatasa oma kallimale helistada, mis ei jää proua Stocklil muidugi kahe silma vahele.

programme.title: Lena Lorenz
programme.desc: Sally põgeneb koos pojaga. Vinz veab Evat koledal kombel alt ja Eva õhtu võtab hoopis teise pöörde, kui ta lootis. Kogemata kombel tekib Almwirtis spontaanne pidu. Hannel tuleb mõte, kuidas võiks kõrtsi edasi majandada. Lena ei võta uudist mängumajast sugugi juubeldades vastu.

programme.title: Proua Fazilet ja tema tütred
programme.desc: Kerime ja Hazani tüli sunnib Sinani silmitsi seisma oma elu kõige valusama tõega, samal ajal kui Fazilet leiab viisi Yasemini kõige nõrgemast kohast rünnata. Šokist murtud Sinan kaotab enesevalitsuse ning muutub ohtlikult ettearvamatuks. Hazan püüab meeleheitlikult takistada teda tegemast sammu, mis võiks kõik lõplikult hävitada, kuid Sinanit pole enam võimalik peatada.

programme.title: Kellele kuulub su süda?
programme.desc: Vicki tunneb, kuidas ta jõuab Simonile üha lähemale. Samal ajal tekib tal kahtlus, et kitsekasvataja Rudil, kes põdes Q-palavikku, ei ole vaimse tervisega kõik korras. Koos Simoniga sõidavad ta tema juurde ja jõuavad viimasel minutil ära hoida enesetapu. Isa ja Lukas valmistuvad adopteerimiseks. Alexandra ja Fabian arutavad, mida Georgiga teha. Külas möllab jätkuvalt kullapalavik.

programme.title: Kuldvillak
programme.desc: Eesti armastatuim mälumäng, kus vastused saavad uued küsimused. Põnev kaasaelamine ja võimalus ka kodus kaasa nuputada. Saatejuht on Eeva Esse-Sõõrumaa.

Kaasakiskuvat ja huvitavat stuudio mälumängu juhib Jüri Butšakov.

programme.title: Papsid
programme.desc: Sarja neljas hooaeg toob kaasa ootamatud pöörded! Toomas seisab silmitsi sotsiaalameti tähelepanuga ning kaalub tagasikolimist Võrumaale, mis tekitab pingeid Sassuga. Samal ajal saab Raivo pitsaäri ootamatu tõuke tuntud juutuuberi kaudu, kuid tema suhe Marikaga pannakse proovile salapärase austaja ilmumisega. Aleksi südant puudutab unistuste naine Andra - tee tema südamesse osutub aga keeruliseks katsumuseks. Hooaja avaosas üritab Marika Mutti Kristiina eest varjata, aga see ei õnnestu. Aleks on veendunud, et sotsiaalametile Toomase kohta anonüümse kaebuse saatnud isik on tema ämm. Linda ei kannata enam Jareki käitumist välja ning läheb ööseks ema juurde.

programme.title: Kuldne pilet
programme.desc: Jätkame elamusliku rännakuga luksuse maailmas. Saatejuht Keili Sükijainen astub Dubais superjahi pardale, millel viibimise eest tuleb maksta 2000 eurot tunnis. Prantsusmaal saame teada, kus kohast tuleb juba aastasadu gurmaane hullutanud kullahinnaga kaaviar ning miks see on nõnda kallis. Lisaks sõidab Keili luksuslikule õhtusöögile kõrbesse. Aga kas suure raha eest saab vaid suu liiva täis?

programme.title: Heeringas Veenuse õlal
programme.desc: Vaimukad sketšid toovad meieni armastatud Eesti näitlejad. Osades Taavi Teplenkov, Tiit Sukk, Marilyn Jurman, Tiina Tauraite, Margus Prangel ja Liina Vahtrik.

programme.title: James May: meie mees Jaapanis
programme.desc: James paneb Firenzes proovile oma renessansiajastu mehe võimed spordialal, mis hõlmab kunsti, teadust ja alkeemiat. Emilia ja Romagna tutvuvad kiirelt liikuvate autode ja aeglaselt laagerduvate juustude maailmaga ning James leiab end viimaks veidral kombel tuttavana tunduvast linnast.

programme.title: Viimane võmm
programme.desc: Legendaarne vehklemistreener Martin Kuusberg on tapetud. Selgub, et ka Prikk on noorena tema vehklemistrennis käinud. Kahtluse alla satuvad tippvehklejad Tõnu Väärtnõu ja Torsten Simm, klubi arst Maara Tali ja klubi omanik Harri Paerand. Mikk vilistab taas kord reeglitele ning saab teada, et mõrvamotiiv on doping. Mikul on samal ajal teised mured, autoremondimees teatab, et tema vanal Volvol on aeg romulasse kolida. Tamara aitab Mikul Volvo päästa ja saab väärilise autasu. Tammets on korteri ostnud ja Rita juurest ära kolinud. Mikk saab tema poolelioleva remondiga toa endale.

programme.title: Küladetektiivid
programme.desc: Kuriteopaigale jõudes tabab uurijaid kurb üllatus - kahe aasta eest tapeti samas majas selle omanik Maria Wittenberg, nüüd aga tuleb välja uurida Maria toonase elukaaslase surma asjaolud. Esimese vihje annab Prantlile ja Hansenile Roland Morchel, rääkides Thomas Wolfi tülist tapetuga. Vaatamata keerulisele uurimistööle leiab Prantl aega alatasa oma kallimale helistada, mis ei jää proua Stocklil muidugi kahe silma vahele.

programme.title: Papsid
programme.desc: Sarja neljas hooaeg toob kaasa ootamatud pöörded! Toomas seisab silmitsi sotsiaalameti tähelepanuga ning kaalub tagasikolimist Võrumaale, mis tekitab pingeid Sassuga. Samal ajal saab Raivo pitsaäri ootamatu tõuke tuntud juutuuberi kaudu, kuid tema suhe Marikaga pannakse proovile salapärase austaja ilmumisega. Aleksi südant puudutab unistuste naine Andra - tee tema südamesse osutub aga keeruliseks katsumuseks. Hooaja avaosas üritab Marika Mutti Kristiina eest varjata, aga see ei õnnestu. Aleks on veendunud, et sotsiaalametile Toomase kohta anonüümse kaebuse saatnud isik on tema ämm. Linda ei kannata enam Jareki käitumist välja ning läheb ööseks ema juurde.

programme.title: Läbi suve Taaviga
programme.desc: TV3 läbi suve kestev meeleolukas rännak läbi Eesti, mida veab iga eestlasega muhedalt jutu peale saav Taavi Libe. Taavi eest ei jää varjatuks ükski kodumaa kant, kus on leida huvitavaid inimesi või erilisi sündmusi.

programme.title: Läbi suve Taaviga
programme.desc: TV3 läbi suve kestev meeleolukas rännak läbi Eesti, mida veab iga eestlasega muhedalt jutu peale saav Taavi Libe. Taavi eest ei jää varjatuks ükski kodumaa kant, kus on leida huvitavaid inimesi või erilisi sündmusi.

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Marion näeb juhuslikult pealt mõrva, aga paraku selgub, et mitte keegi ei usu teda. Mida nüüd ette võtta? Loomulikult tuleb tal ise juhtumit lahendama hakata ning selleks peab ta taaskord prostituudiks kehastuma. Asja ligemalt uurides selgub Marionile, et lilleäri võib olla ülimalt kriminaalne ja ohtlik valdkond.

programme.title: Suvesangarid
programme.desc: "Suvesangarid" on lustlik suvine saade, mis tõestab, et igas Eestimaa nurgas on midagi vaatamist ja katsetamist väärt. Kartmatud saatejuhid Indrek Vaheoja ja Kristjan Rabi proovivad erinevaid ameteid, võtavad vastu külalisi ja jagavad ellujäämise saladusi neljal õhtul nädalas. Lisaks saab Eestimaa kirjust suvest osa vaatajate koduvideote kaudu.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Poeet (Henrik Normann) hakkab peremehe tellimusel Rebekka (Merle Palmiste) jaoks armastusluuletust kirjutama. Jürka (Ago Anderson) proovib traktorist Elmari abiga Rebekka haagissuvilat oma tarele lähemale sikutada. Urmasel (Sepo Seeman) on kõigi teistega nii palju tegemist, et Riina (Hilje Murel) otsustab nördinult talust põgeneda. Sündmused lõppevad pauguga, mille tagajärjed on valusad. Stsenarist Peep Pedmanson, reþissöör Rando Pettai. Tootja Ruut.

programme.title: Märgatud Eestis
programme.desc: Tartus Raadil on vanas varjendis end sisse seadnud mees ja naine. Teeme nendega tutvust ning nad näitavad oma eluolu. Miks nad on ometi sellise elukoha ja eluviisi valinud? Järjekordne uskumatu reportaaž Taavi Libelt.
